sources.title: Spec: hako v1 — model-agnostic agent-loop runner (pipeline kernel)
sources.snippet: Execution follows the docker model: hakod (daemon) hosts the engine wherever it runs — laptop or server, same binary — and hako (CLI) is a pure client that submits runs, streams events, and hands answers back. Every iteration runs in a fresh ephemeral microVM (smolvm) with a fresh agent context; the only memory channel is the persistent workspace (a run-owned git clone on a run branch ...
